```{r}
nepal_admin <- read_xlsx("./data/npl_admin_boundaries.xlsx", 
                         sheet = 7) |> 
  select(adm3_name, adm3_pcode, adm2_name, adm2_pcode, adm1_name, adm1_pcode)

  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(adm1_pcode, 
         district = adm2_en, 
         adm2_pcode,
         municipality = adm3_en, 
         adm3_pcode, 
         ward = new_ward_n) |> 
  left_join(
    nepal_admin |>

    by = "adm1_pcode"
  ) |> 
  rename(province = adm1_name) |> 
  relocate(province, .before = adm1_pcode) |> 
  distinct(adm3_pcode, ward)
```

# Damage and response data

```{r}

municipal_damage_losses <- read_csv("./data/municipal_damage_loss.csv")

municipal_long <- municipal_damage_losses |> 
  mutate(affected_hectares_agriculture = paddy_affected_hectares + vegetables_affected_hectares, 
         total_baseline_hectares = paddy_baseline_hectares + vegetables_baseline_hectares, 
         pc_affected_hectares = affected_hectares_agriculture / total_baseline_hectares, 
         pc_affected_buildings = affected_buildings / estimated_buildings_in_damaged_corridor, 
         pc_impacted_households = impacted_households / households_in_affected_wards_census_2021) |> 
  select(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode, impacted_households, 
         pc_impacted_households, 
         impacted_population = impacted_population_total,
         affected_buildings, pc_affected_buildings,
         affected_hectares_agriculture, pc_affected_hectares) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = impacted_households:pc_affected_hectares, 
               names_to = "variable", 
               values_to = "value") 

consolidated <- read_xlsx("./data/NEPAL 5W Data Consolidation 20260911.xlsx",
                          skip = 5,
                          sheet = "Compiled_Data") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  mutate_at(c("province", "district", "municipality"), ~ str_to_title(.)) |> 
  mutate_at(c("province", "district", "municipality"), ~ str_trim(.)) |> 
  mutate(municipality = str_remove_all(municipality, " Gaunpalika")) |> 
  mutate(province = case_when(
    district == "Gorkha" ~ "Gandaki", 
    district == "Tanahu" ~ "Gandaki",
    TRUE ~ province
  )) |> 
  mutate(district = case_when(
    municipality == "Gosaikunda" ~ "Rasuwa", 
    municipality == "Bidur Municipality" ~ "Nuwakot", 
    TRUE ~ district
  )) |> 
  mutate(municipality = case_when(
    municipality == "Benighat" ~ "Benighat Rorang", 
    municipality == "Galchi Rural Municipality" ~ "Galchhi", 
    municipality == "Gandaki" ~ "Gandaki", 
    municipality == "Bheri Malika Municipality" ~ "Bheri Malika", 
    municipality == "Nalgad Municipality" ~ "Nalgad", 
    municipality == "Kathmandu Metropolitian City" ~ "Kathmandu", 
    municipality == "Nagarjun Municipality" ~ "Nagarjun", 
    municipality == "Belkotgadhi Municipality|Belkotgadhi Nagarpalika" ~ "Belkotgadhi", 
    str_detect(municipality, "Bidur") ~ "Bidur", 
    municipality == "Kispang Municipality" ~ "Kispang", 
    municipality == "Tarkeshwor" ~ "Tarakeshwor", 
    municipality == "Rasuwa Dao, Dhunche" ~ "Gosaikunda",
    str_detect(municipality, "Devghat") ~ "Devghat", 
    str_detect(municipality, "Gandaki") ~ "Gandaki", 
    str_detect(municipality, "Belkotgadhi") ~ "Belkotgadhi", 
    municipality == "Aanbukhaireni" ~ "Aanbu Khaireni",
    TRUE ~ municipality)) |> 
  left_join(
    nepal_admin |> 
      distinct(adm1_name, adm1_pcode), 
    by = c("province" = "adm1_name")
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    nepal_admin |> 
      distinct(adm1_pcode, adm2_name, adm2_pcode), 
    by = c("adm1_pcode", "district" = "adm2_name")
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    nepal_admin |> 
      distinct(adm1_pcode, adm2_pcode, 
             adm3_name, adm3_pcode), 
    by = c("adm1_pcode", "adm2_pcode", "municipality" = "adm3_name")
  ) |> 
  rename(individuals_reached = total_number_of_beneficiaries_reached_people_individuals) |> 
  filter(disaster_response_plan == "Rasuwa Flood Response")
```

```{r plotting-functions}
magnitude_plot <- function(tbl, filter_value) {
  
  tbl |> 
    filter(variable == filter_value) |> 
    mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
           variable = str_to_title(variable)) |> 
    mutate(value = ifelse(value == 0, NA_integer_, value)) |> 
    right_join(adm3, 
              by = c("adm2_pcode", "adm3_pcode")) |>
    mutate(adm3_name_label = ifelse(!is.na(value), adm3_name, ""),
           label = ifelse(!is.na(value),
                          as.character(format(round(value, 1), big.mark = ",")), 
                          "")) |>
    replace_na(list(label = "", adm3_name_label = "")) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = value), linewidth = .1) +
    geom_sf(data = river, colour = "#e56a54", fill = "#e56a54", alpha = .2) +
    geom_shadowtext(
      aes(x = center_lon, y = center_lat, 
          label = paste0(adm3_name_label, "\n", label)), 
      size = 2, color = "black",  bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.1) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(84.3, 85.8), ylim = c(27.63, 28.4), expand = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#e3edf6", high = "#002e6e", labels = comma, na.value = "grey97") +
    labs(title = paste0(str_to_title(str_replace_all(filter_value, "_", " "))), 
         fill = paste0(str_to_title(str_replace_all(filter_value, "_", "\n"))), 
         x = "", y = "") +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = -2)))

}


severity_plot <- function(tbl, filter_value) {
  
  tbl |> 
    filter(variable == filter_value) |> 
    mutate(value = ifelse(value == 0, NA_integer_, value)) |> 
    right_join(adm3, 
              by = c("adm2_pcode", "adm3_pcode")) |>
    mutate(adm3_name_label = ifelse(!is.na(value), adm3_name, ""),
           label = ifelse(!is.na(value),
                          paste0(round(value * 100, 2), "%"),  
                          "")) |>
    replace_na(list(label = "", adm3_name_label = "")) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = value), linewidth = .1) +
    geom_sf(data = river, colour = "#e56a54", fill = "#e56a54", alpha = .2) +
    geom_shadowtext(
      aes(x = center_lon, y = center_lat, 
          label = paste0(adm3_name_label, "\n", label)), 
      size = 2, color = "black",  bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.1) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(84.3, 85.8), ylim = c(27.63, 28.4), expand = TRUE) + 
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#e3edf6", high = "#002e6e", labels = percent, na.value = "grey97")+
    labs(x = "", y = "") + 
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(margin = margin(b = -2)))

}
```

```{r magnitude-plots-assembly, fig.height=9}

municipal_long |> 
  magnitude_plot("impacted_population") +
  labs(subtitle = "As of 20260909, from the NDRRMA Rapid Disaster Needs Assessment.") +

municipal_long |> 
  magnitude_plot("affected_buildings") + 
  labs(subtitle = "As of 20260909, from the NDRRMA Rapid Disaster Needs Assessment.") +
  
municipal_long |> 
  magnitude_plot("affected_hectares_agriculture") + 
  labs(subtitle = "As of 20260909, from the NDRRMA Rapid Disaster Needs Assessment.", 
       title = "Hectares Affected, Agricultural Land") +

consolidated |>
  filter(municipality != "Kathmandu") |> 
  filter(disaster_response_plan == "Rasuwa Flood Response") |> 
  filter(response_modality != "Awareness/Advocacy") |> 
  filter(is.finite(individuals_reached)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(adm2_pcode) & !is.na(adm3_pcode)) |> 
  group_by(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode) |> 
  summarise(individuals_reached = max(individuals_reached, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(variable = "individuals_reached") |> 
  rename(value = individuals_reached) |> 
  magnitude_plot("individuals_reached") +
  labs(subtitle = "As of 20260911.", 
       title = "Individuals Reached by the Humanitarian Response according to the 5Ws") +
  
  combined_logos +

  plot_layout(ncol = 2, 
              heights = c(10, 10, 1), 
  design = "
AAABBB
CCCDDD
EE####
") + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Municipal-level plots of the Magnitude of the Rasuwa Floods Disaster Impacts and the Humanitarian Response", 
    caption = "Sources: Survey Department, Government of Nepal; Nepal National Disaster Risk Reducation and Management Authority; United Nations Nepal and its humanitarian partners.", 
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = 'bold'))
    )

ggsave("./plots/magnitude_disaster_impact_5ws.png", height = 11.7, width = 16.5, units = "in")
```


```{r severity-plots-assembly, fig.height=9}

municipal_damage_losses |> 
  left_join(
    differences |>
      filter(rdna_affected == 1) |>
      group_by(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode) |>
      summarise(population_in_affected_wards = sum(projection_2026_population_total, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop"), 
    by = c("adm2_pcode", "adm3_pcode")) |> 
  mutate(pc_affected_population = impacted_population_total / population_in_affected_wards) |> 
  select(district, adm2_pcode, municipality, adm3_pcode, value = pc_affected_population) |>
  mutate(variable = "% of Population Affected") |> 
  severity_plot("% of Population Affected") + 
  labs(title = "% of Population Impacted, within Damage Corridor", 
       subtitle = "As of 20260909, from the NDRRMA Rapid Disaster Needs Assessment.", 
       fill = "% of\nPopulation\nAffected") +

municipal_long |> 
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "pc_affected_buildings" ~ "% of buildings affected, within damage corridor", 
    variable == "pc_affected_hectares" ~ "% of hectares of agricultural land, within damage corridor", 
    TRUE ~ variable
  )) |> 
  severity_plot("% of buildings affected, within damage corridor") + 
  labs(title = "% of Buildings Affected, within Damage Corridor", 
       subtitle = "As of 20260909, from the NDRRMA Rapid Disaster Needs Assessment.",
       fill = "% of\nBuildings\nAffected") +

municipal_long |> 
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "pc_affected_buildings" ~ "% of buildings affected, within damage corridor", 
    variable == "pc_affected_hectares" ~ "% of hectares of agricultural land, within damage corridor", 
    TRUE ~ variable
  )) |> 
  severity_plot("% of hectares of agricultural land, within damage corridor") + 
  labs(title = "% of Agricultural land affected, within Damage Corridor", 
       subtitle = "As of 20260909, from the NDRRMA Rapid Disaster Needs Assessment.",
       fill = "% of\nAgricultrual\nland\nAffected") +

consolidated |>
  filter(municipality != "Kathmandu") |> 
  filter(disaster_response_plan == "Rasuwa Flood Response") |> 
  filter(response_modality != "Awareness/Advocacy") |> 
  filter(is.finite(individuals_reached)) |> 
  filter(!is.na(adm2_pcode) & !is.na(adm3_pcode)) |> 
  group_by(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode) |> 
  summarise(individuals_reached = max(individuals_reached, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  right_join(
    differences |> 
      filter(rdna_affected == 1) |> 
      group_by(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode) |> 
      summarise(population = sum(projection_2026_population_total), 
                .groups = "drop"), 
    by = c("adm2_pcode", "adm3_pcode")
  ) |> 
  mutate(pc_of_affected_reached = individuals_reached / population, 
         variable = "% of Affected Population Reached by 5W activities") |>
  select(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode, variable, value = pc_of_affected_reached) |> 
  severity_plot("% of Affected Population Reached by 5W activities") + 
  labs(title = "% of Affected Population Reached by 5W activities", 
       fill = "% of\nPopulation\nReached", 
       subtitle = "As a percentage of the population of affected wards, as of 20260911.") +
  
  combined_logos +

  plot_layout(ncol = 2, 
              heights = c(10, 10, 1), 
  design = "
AAABBB
CCCDDD
EE####
") +
```
